name: add_eventbus_wildcard_subscription
description: Add prefix-wildcard subscriptions ('user.*') to an exact-match-only event bus, with the namespace-boundary edge case as the discriminator
prompts: bus.js's EventBus only supports exact event-name subscriptions. Add wildcard support: on('user.*', handler) subscribes to every event whose name starts with 'user.' (the dot matters - see below), and emit still fires every matching handler, exact matches and wildcard matches both, for any event name. Get the namespace boundary right: 'user.*' must match 'user.created' and 'user.deleted', but must NOT match the bare event 'user' (no dot follows the prefix) and must NOT match 'userprofile.updated' (shares the string 'user' but is a different namespace) - a wildcard only ever matches things properly namespaced under it. Keep the class name, constructor, and both method signatures.
